title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: Each transaction is looked at on its own, and there's no overall cap. I can refund a settled card purchase myself if it's $75.00 or less, less than 30 days old, hasn't been refunded before and the card isn't frozen. Bigger or older charges, money sent to another person, and charges on a frozen card go to a person on our support team to review instead.
